adaptation.hook_prompt: Fixed high-corner backyard security-camera view of a sunny suburban backyard with a pool and lawn, a small American flag on the porch rail. A young brown-haired woman in a plain white T-shirt and denim shorts skims leaves from the pool with a net; a cream snow Bengal cat with tan rosettes and clear blue eyes dashes out of the open back door, across the lawn and toward the fence. She drops the net and runs after it. Static camera, no zoom. No product anywhere in frame. Natural sound only: water, birds, footsteps. No background music, no text, no captions, no logos.
adaptation.startframe: iPhone photo from a fixed high-corner backyard security camera: a sunny suburban backyard with a pool and lawn, a small American flag on the porch rail, a young brown-haired woman in a plain white T-shirt and denim shorts skimming the pool with a net, the back door open, a cream snow Bengal cat with tan rosettes and clear blue eyes stepping out onto the patio. No product anywhere in frame. Sharp, clean, realistic phone photo.
